The suite carries `facts`, so the runner drives each cell as one conversation and grades it with `--scenario` - the step each fact was first stated at, the transcript length there, and the first fact never stated. `full` only, because steps 3 to 7 need the `ioctl` group; a narrower surface breaks at step 3 for the surface's reason, which the grade reports as `surface` and is worth one cell at most. The windows are the axis: at 262144 the surface and the transcript both fit, so a break is the model's; at 32768 the full surface takes a large share of the window before the first result lands - its size is in every record's `surface.bytes`, so read it there rather than from an older grid - and a step whose chat fails is graded `error` with the transcript length it was asked at. One draw per cell, so this reads where runs break and not how often. Read after the run (2026-10-18): the windows were not an axis. `/api/ps` reported the 32,768 cells served 32,768, and one of them evaluated a 79,352-token prompt and answered from text 49,000 tokens back, so on this MLX runtime the smaller figure bounds nothing and both windows ran at the models' own 262,144. `eval_plan_scenario_reasoning.json` runs one window for that reason, and `FOLLOWUPS.md` item 132 is the window this plan meant to test.
